name: ccfa-skills
description: A coordinated skill family for CCF research papers.

interface.shortDescription: Research skills from idea to submission.
interface.longDescription: Eighteen focused skills help researchers develop ideas, gather evidence, design and debug experiments, write and review manuscripts, create scientific figures, and prepare submissions while preserving a coherent research story.
interface.defaultPrompt: Apply ccf-humanization, then ccf-common before the relevant CCFA specialist. Reuse active preflights, preserve evidence and terminology, and integrate necessary contributions within the requested scope.
